issue_context.title: Various Coverity Issues
issue_context.body:
Hi, We have found and addressed some of the static analysis issues found in our Coverity builds OpenSSL 1.1.1.
Checking if SA issues are being in 1.1.1 are being addressed and also if a PR for our fixes would be accepted?
Most of these are memory leaks and then a few other issues. diffs attached.
[coverity-diff.txt](https://github.com/openssl/openssl/files/4974073/coverity-diff.txt)

Thanks,
Norman
